explanation.text:
VEND MARKETPLACES ASA (org.nr 933 739 384) is registered as Allmennaksjeselskap (ASA), founded 1953-11-26, registered 1995-02-19. Business address: Grensen 5, 0159 OSLO. Main industry (NACE): 46.710 Engroshandel med motorvogner. Latest filed annual accounts (2025, company statement): revenue NOK 91,000,000; operating result NOK -312,000,000; net result NOK 4,079,000,000; total assets NOK 34,392,000,000; equity NOK 30,050,000,000 (the group statement for the same year reports revenue NOK 6,317,000,000). Leadership: general manager (daglig leder) Christian Printzell Halvorsen; board chair Karl Christian Agerup; 9 other board members. Sub-units registered: 2. Website: www.vend.com. The website describes the company as: "Formerly Schibsted Marketplaces, we operate some of the most trusted platforms in the Nordics — FINN, Blocket, DBA, Bilbasen, Tori and Oikotie. Our vision is simple but powerful: smart choices made easy. ‌﻿‍﻿​‍​‍‌‍﻿﻿‌﻿​‍" LEI: 5967007LIEEXZXHT0O36 (ACTIVE). Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vend_Marketplaces_ASA.

- wikidata: item carries P2333 = org number
